admin.title: Administration
admin.signInPrompt: Sign in with your organization account to open the administration dashboard.
admin.signInFailed: Sign-in could not be started. Try again later.
admin.noRole: Your account has no administration role yet. If you received an invitation, open the link in that e-mail.

accept.title: Accept invitation
accept.missingToken: This invitation link is incomplete or was already used on this page. Open the link from the invitation e-mail again.

accept.reloginRequired: Your new role takes effect the next time you sign in.

accept.failed: The invitation could not be accepted

problem.invitationInvalid: This invitation is not valid: it does not exist, was revoked or was already accepted.
problem.invitationMismatch: This invitation was issued for another account. Sign out, then sign in through your organization with the e-mail address the invitation was sent to.
problem.signInAgain: Your session has expired. Sign in again.
problem.insufficientAcr: This requires a sign-in with a second factor. Sign in again.
problem.noRole: Your account has no administration role.
problem.forbidden: Your account is not allowed to do this.
problem.network: The server could not be reached. Check your connection and try again.
problem.generic: Something went wrong. Try again later.
